card.name: And in oligohydramnios complications list
card.fires_on: The word "and" joining items in a list of complications of prolonged oligohydramnios, right after "limb contractures". Only one passage appears in the contexts, repeated.

modes.label: And in fetal complication list
modes.description: The word "and" between listed fetal complications, here between limb contractures and delayed lung maturation.
modes.example: Complications of prolonged oligohydramnios may, for example, include limb contractures<< and>> delayed lung maturation.

card.plain: It fires on the word "and" in one sentence listing fetal problems from low amniotic fluid.
